content: PostgreSQL docs (sql-insert.html): ON CONFLICT conflict_target = (cols) [WHERE index_predicate]; index_predicate 'Used to allow inference of partial unique indexes... Follows CREATE INDEX format'. Example verified: ON CONFLICT (did) WHERE is_active DO NOTHING infers partial unique index on did WHERE is_active. DO NOTHING with omitted target handles all constraints; DO UPDATE requires target. Only NOT DEFERRABLE unique indexes are arbiters. Caveat: while CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY runs on a unique index, ON CONFLICT inserts may fail with unique violation - ordering note for Phase 3.
